tiers.usage: May support current SAP-specific behavior when product version and retrieval date match.
May support learning scope; implementation claims still require Help/API documentation.
May illustrate code/configuration; verify branch, release, license, and current support status.
Legacy context only; never imply current support without a current source.
Record metadata and access gap; do not claim gated details were inspected.
Scenarios and hypotheses only; cross-check every platform claim.
Teaching interpretation and operational heuristics only; cross-check platform behavior.
Question discovery and failure scenarios only; never authoritative.

publicationRule: A completed module needs at least three applicable official references, explicit version scope, and recorded unresolved gaps. Supplementary sources never satisfy the official minimum alone.
